> Viltrox has added another tempting option to its ever-expanding autofocus range with the AF 26mm F2.8 EVO, a compact full-frame pancake lens built for everyday carry. Available in Sony E and Nikon Z mounts, it is aimed at street photography, architecture, environmental portraits, travel and general visual storytelling — the sort of grab-and-go lens that stays on the camera rather than in the bag. On paper it looks like classic Viltrox: sensible specification, genuinely useful design, and a price that undercuts the competition. The headline feature for us is the handling. This is a pancake lens with both a dedicated aperture ring and a separate focus ring, a level of tactile control that is genuinely rare in this slimline category — most pancakes force you to give up physical controls in the name of size.
